en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with multi‑story historic buildings and dormer windows surrounding an open cobbled plaza. A horse‑drawn carriage, several pedestrians, and a child with a bicycle appear in the foreground. Large church roofs and multiple tall spires rise behind the row of houses. The town name "Lommatzsch." is printed at the top in red, and publisher information appears at the bottom left.
